plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, asks a scientist who scanned beneath the pyramids about Ben van Kerkwijk, a researcher who recently talked on Joe Rogan's popular podcast about a huge labyrinth said to lie in the Hawara area of Egypt. The story leans on ancient writers, the Greek historian Herodotus and the Roman author Pliny the Elder, who described such a labyrinth. If true, it would mean a vast ancient structure is still hidden under the ground there.
